profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Etsy

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description: Trucost is the world leader in natural capital valuation and provides expert environmental research and business intelligence. Trucost datasets and models help investors and corporations understand environmental impacts, and the use of natural resources in global economies, business operations, supply chains and investment portfolios.

positions.title: Sustainability Consultant
positions.description: UL Environment helps companies evolve, execute and communicate their sustainability strategies and initiatives with advisory services and expertise that supports the decision-making process every step of the way, including market research and strategy development.

positions.title: Sustainability Analyst
positions.description: Delivered customized enterprise and product-level sustainability solutions for clients in a number of sectors. Contributed to business development by building written proposals and creative concept presentations for clients, and assisting in go-to-market strategies.

positions.title: Energy Portal Consultant, Sustainable Energy Programme, Energy & Environment Group
positions.description: Collected and analyzed sustainable energy project data from the UNDP Energy Portfolio, with a focus on energy access in developing countries. Liaised with regional service centres, global energy team counterparts, and environment & energy focal points in country offices, producing in a meaningful quantitative and qualitative impact assessment of the portfolio.

positions.title: Sustainability Consultant
positions.description: Evaluated proposed Port of Gulfport restoration plan and investigated green port best practices to incorporate into a revised plan, along with a team and input from community partners. Developed a comprehensive report on green practices in port design and a set of sustainability guidelines for submission to the Mississippi Development Authority and the Mississippi Port Authority.

positions.title: Sustainability Program Coordinator
positions.description: Managed and administered both federal and private grants supporting the sustainability of rural communities along the Lower North Shore of Québec.

courses.name: Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Training
